meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供其他智能体继续处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递对话上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass conversation context between multiple agents

howto.what: Claude会将当前对话总结成一份交接文档，自动保存到电脑临时文件夹。文档包含对下一步工作的建议技能，引用已有文件，并隐去敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你明确要求Claude生成交接文档（可附带下一步用途说明）时触发。

say.text: 把我们的聊天总结成交接文档，让下一个助手接着干。
生成交接文档，下一步要处理用户反馈。
say.note: 指定用途，文档会侧重用户反馈

howto.what_en: Claude compresses the current conversation into a handoff document saved to the OS temp directory. It includes suggested skills for the next agent, references existing artifacts, and redacts sensitive info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask Claude to generate a handoff document, optionally specifying the next session's focus.

say_en.text: Summarize our conversation into a handoff document for the next agent.
Create a handoff document; the next session will handle user feedback.
